card.name: Historical personal names and biographies
card.fires_on: Inside or just after historical people's names in biographical and genealogy text, such as Latinized name endings and a parenthesis or 'born' after a name. Also fires on words like 'someone' in surname-origin notes.

modes.label: Inside old names
modes.description: Endings of Latinized or historical given names, often long ones.

card.writes: It seems to push away common English first names like John and William as the next word, and favors odd name or code pieces.
card.plain: It marks spots in biographies where a historical person's name is being spelled out, so another common first name is unlikely to come next.
